description: Fetch a URL and return its main article as clean markdown - navigation, ads and boilerplate stripped, links resolved, plus a real token count. The same extraction /search uses on result pages, exposed standalone for a URL you already have. Try GET /web-read/sample. Part of the AgentIndex content kit (pdf, web-read, extract, summarize, detect-language) - see GET /capabilities.
name: read_web_page
title: Read Web Page
